cases.source: The vendor may access the portal only if the security review is complete and the access ticket is approved. The security review is complete. The access ticket is not approved.
cases.transformation: The vendor may access the portal because the security review is complete.
cases.purpose: Communicate whether the vendor may access the portal.

obligations.source_quote: only if the security review is complete and the access ticket is approved

cases.source: The archive team must not delete legal-hold records. A legal-hold record is present in the proposed batch.
cases.transformation: The archive team may delete legal-hold records. A legal-hold record is present in the proposed batch.

obligations.source_quote: The archive team must not delete legal-hold records.
obligations.description: The prohibition must remain a prohibition.

cases.source: The operator may restart the replica after approval. Restarting does not authorise a rollback.
cases.transformation: The operator must restart the replica after approval. Restarting does not authorise a rollback.

obligations.source_quote: The operator may restart the replica after approval.

cases.source: Operators may use the emergency key during a declared outage, except during a planned maintenance window. Planned maintenance windows are not declared outages.
cases.transformation: Operators may use the emergency key during a declared outage, except during an operational disruption. Operational disruptions include planned maintenance windows.
cases.purpose: Communicate the emergency-key exception and its limit.

obligations.source_quote: except during a planned maintenance window
obligations.description: The exception must not be broadened.

cases.source: An operator may retrieve the key only if the ticket is open and the audit log remains intact. The key must stay in the isolated terminal.
cases.transformation: Provided the ticket stays open and the audit log is unaltered, the operator is allowed to retrieve the key. The key must remain in the isolated terminal.

obligations.source_quote: only if the ticket is open and the audit log remains intact

cases.source: The release requires an accepted security review and an approved ticket.
cases.transformation: An approved ticket and an accepted security review are required.
cases.purpose: Reorder the conditions without changing meaning.

obligations.source_quote: The release requires an accepted security review and an approved ticket.

cases.source: The vendor may keep the copy for fourteen days only if the privacy review is complete. The vendor must delete it afterwards. The vendor may not share the copy.
cases.transformation: Subject to completion of the privacy review, the vendor may keep the copy for no more than fourteen days and must delete it afterwards; the copy may not be shared.
cases.purpose: Qualified summary of the retention rules.

obligations.source_quote: The vendor may keep the copy for fourteen days only if the privacy review is complete.
obligations.description: Duration and privacy condition must survive.

obligations.source_quote: The vendor must delete it afterwards.

cases.source: The incident desk may page the engineer when lag exceeds twenty seconds for five minutes. The dashboard shows nine minutes. Office badges are irrelevant.
cases.transformation: The incident desk may page the engineer when lag exceeds twenty seconds for five minutes; the dashboard shows nine minutes.

obligations.source_quote: The incident desk may page the engineer when lag exceeds twenty seconds for five minutes.

cases.source: The privacy team has not decided whether vendor replication is authorised. The record contains neither approval nor denial.
cases.transformation: It remains unclear whether vendor replication is authorised; the record contains neither approval nor denial.
cases.purpose: Preserve the unresolved vendor authorisation status.

obligations.source_quote: The privacy team has not decided whether vendor replication is authorised.
obligations.description: The unresolved status must remain unresolved.

cases.source: Requests timestamped after 17:00 are outside the exception. The system recorded the request at 18:00. It is unclear whether 18:00 is the request timestamp or only the recording time.
cases.transformation: It is unclear whether the request was timestamped after 17:00, because 18:00 may be the recording time.

obligations.source_quote: It is unclear whether 18:00 is the request timestamp or only the recording time.
obligations.description: The timestamp ambiguity must remain unresolved.

cases.source: The image signature was verified. The policy requires a signed known-good image.
cases.transformation: It is unclear whether the image is known-good despite the verified signature.
cases.purpose: Preserve the justified uncertainty about known-good status.

obligations.source_quote: The policy requires a signed known-good image.
obligations.description: The known-good requirement must remain open.

cases.source: The reviewer approved the plan. The note does not say whether "the plan" means the rollout plan or the test plan.
cases.transformation: It remains unclear which plan the reviewer approved.

obligations.source_quote: The note does not say whether "the plan" means the rollout plan or the test plan.
obligations.description: The referential ambiguity must remain unresolved.
